title: Clocks between the animations
summary: The 112 clocks of seed 52 tracked in collection/card/clocks/ by the collection's standard, and the installation's name, made from the owner's page, as a message in clocks/message/; Settings gets two checkboxes kept on the board: a clock from a random order that plays each once, after every 5 animations or when 5 minutes have passed, cutting and then resuming the animation that plays, and the message flashing once after each clock; the commands clocks on|off and clocks message on|off, clocks.txt, two status members, and --drive-folder for the emulator.
